author: The Critical Drinker
description:
With the Paramount/WB merger stalled by Californian legal challenges, David Ellison dropped a nuke on California by threatening to move all Paramount productions out of the state. Meanwhile, WB themselves are rumoured to be re-releasing director's cuts of Snyderverse movies next year. Oh yeah, and for some reason William Shatner's in a feud with Nerdrotic. Just a normal week, then.
